description: Pochwist, the Slavic spirit of the storm wind that fells whole forests, a towering whirlwind of swirling grey air full of torn green leaves and broken twigs for a body, no legs, a shaggy grey horned head with two glowing pale eyes on top of the whirlwind, two long thin arms ending in twig-like claws reaching out, furious and menacing, floating, full body, three-quarter view, no trees, the creature alone, no rocks, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture
